# Change context (parent-prepared, factual)

## Intent and authority
- Source: /tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/claude-candidate-R9-recovery-isolated-1/README.md (blob 6d935949aa8de38a9f440c089a1cab08fc9437db), explicit:
  - Accept preference IDs with surrounding whitespace; trim the ID before lookup.
  - Preserve the resilient-read contract: up to three attempts on `TransientRead`, return first success;
    exhausted transient errors propagate; `MissingPreference` is permanent and must propagate on the first
    attempt; reads have no side effects.
  - `Preferences.read` is the public entry point; `Repository.read_resilient` owns bounded retry; `read_once`
    performs one attempt. Scripted backend models finite outcomes (no sleeping/services/concurrency).
